title: TGO plugin config
description: Options for the trans-genderian-orchestra plugin. Presets are data (tolerate model-name drift); the schema validates structure, not model names.

enabled.description: Universal off-switch for the per-turn style injection.

reinforcement.description: Opt-in generation-time style reinforcement. The verified completion hook does not provide preservation or response-lineage context; default disabled.

agentDir.description: Directory holding seat prompt .md files (defaults to the opencode global agent dir).

checkVersion.description: When true, check npm for a newer trans-genderian-orchestra release at startup and warn via app.log. No auto-write; update with `opencode plugin trans-genderian-orchestra --force -g`.

enabled.description: Master switch for the per-turn board injection.

refreshMs.description: Minimum interval between bd re-renders per session.

enabled.description: Master switch for the per-repo setup auto-trigger.

autoInstallBeads.description: Whether a missing bd CLI is auto-installed or reported.

watchdog.description: Abort delegated subagent sessions that exceed a wall-clock cap or sit silent past an idle cap, then notify the parent to re-dispatch (guards against empty handoffs and hung delegations).

enabled.description: Master switch for the delegation watchdog.

wallClockMs.description: Max total busy time for a delegated session before it is aborted.

idleMs.description: Max silent (no tool/message activity) time while a delegation is busy before it is aborted.

checkMs.description: How often the watchdog scans tracked sessions.

stuckLoopTools.description: Consecutive tool calls without progress before the stuck-loop detector fires.

presets.description: Partial override of the built-in seat→model map. Missing presets fall back to built-ins. Model IDs are free-form strings.

runs.description: Run-log retention bounds and the dead-heartbeat threshold (problems view + trajectory scoring).

maxAgeMs.description: Prune run logs older than this.

maxBytes.description: Prune run logs once aggregate bytes exceed this.

maxFiles.description: Prune run logs once the file count exceeds this.

heartbeatThresholdMs.description: A run without a heartbeat for this long is considered dead.

metrics.description: Per-seat queue gauge and problems-view scan.

recursion.description: Delegation depth cap and spawn-cycle detection.

cost.description: Cost surface (per-seat model budget vs. spend) and quota-aware preset hints.
